Name: Say Hi
Author: gggl634624654567
Description:
Will say Hi to villagers and animals around when play "hi" Emote action, This will increase some Friendship points as same as talking to them.
(Say Hi default range is 5 steps, can be configured)
-----
Talking to villagers and saying hi to villagers only increased friendship points once per day, will not increase repeatedly, although can keep saying hi.
Such as player has already talked to the villagers, then saying hi will not increase friendship points again. The opposite is also true.
It can be thought that saying hi is just a shortcut to automatically talking with the surrounding villagers or pet the surrounding animals.

Usage:
Press the Y key to call up the Emote menu and select the "hi" icon to Say Hi. (if the "hi" icon cannot be found, can right-click on an icon and replace it with "hi" icon)
or  Press the shortcut key to Say Hi. (default key G, can be configured)[s](default F6 in v0.0.1)[/s]


中文说明：
[spoiler]
[b][size=4]打招呼[/size][/b]
做"嗨"的表情动作时自动与周围的村民及动物们打招呼。(默认为5格范围，可以在通用模组配置菜单中修改范围)
-----
与村民打招呼相当于完成每日对话，与动物打招呼相当于完成每日抚摸动作；
打招呼和对话、抚摸一样，可以获得对应的好感值，且每日仅第一次打招呼时会获得好感值；

用法：
按"Y"键打开表情菜单并选择"嗨"表情 (表情菜单中没有"嗨"表情时，可以右键点击一个表情并用"嗨"表情代替它，快捷键Y可以在游戏选项中修改)；
或 按快捷键"G"来做"嗨"的表情动作 (快捷键G可以在通用模组配置菜单中修改)
[/spoiler]
